dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「またお前と一緒になったな。友よ」
dialogues.en: "Once again we are bonded by fate, my friend."
dialogues.text: "Once again we are bonded by fate, my friend."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.en: "Gah."
dialogues.text: "Gah."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「おお！　そんなに喜んでくれるか！　俺は嬉
　しいぞ」
dialogues.en: "Ohh! Such expression of joy! It warms my heart."
dialogues.text: "Ohh! Such expression of joy! It warms my heart."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「……どこをどうやったら、そんな解釈が出て
　くるんだ？」
dialogues.en: "And how did you get that from what I said?"
dialogues.text: "And how did you get that from what I said?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「無論、皮肉だ」
dialogues.en: "Sarcasm, of course."
dialogues.text: "Sarcasm, of course."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「ま、これからまた１年、よろしく頼むぞ。朝
　倉」
dialogues.en:
"Well, for yet another year, let's work well together,
Asakura."
dialogues.text:
"Well, for yet another year, let's work well together,
Asakura."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「ああ」
dialogues.en: "Ahh."
dialogues.text: "Ahh."

dialogues.jp:
そのまま、俺の前の席にどっかり座り込む。席
順はまだ決まっていないので、ＨＲが始まるま
では、めいめい好きな所に居るしかない。
dialogues.en:
I then took a nearby desk and sat at it. Since the seating
order won't be determined till HR, until then, it's free
seating.
dialogues.text:
I then took a nearby desk and sat at it. Since the seating
order won't be determined till HR, until then, it's free
seating.

dialogues.jp:
教室の中には早くもグループが出来ていて、色
んな音の混じり合った雑音を生み出している。
dialogues.en:
Groups were already forming within the class, as people were
quick to introduce themselves to their new classmates.
dialogues.text:
Groups were already forming within the class, as people were
quick to introduce themselves to their new classmates.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「良かったな、朝倉。彼女と一緒になれて」
dialogues.en:
"Good for you, Asakura. In the same class as your
girlfriend."
dialogues.text:
"Good for you, Asakura. In the same class as your
girlfriend."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.en: "Huh?"
dialogues.text: "Huh?"

dialogues.jp:
杉並があごで示した先には、何人かの女子と喋っ
ていることりが居た。
dialogues.en:
Suginami gestured with his chin towards a bunch of girls
talking, of which Kotori was one of them.
dialogues.text:
Suginami gestured with his chin towards a bunch of girls
talking, of which Kotori was one of them.

dialogues.jp: 「まあ、な。というか、お前、知ってたんだな」
dialogues.en: "Ah, that. You know about that now, huh."
dialogues.text: "Ah, that. You know about that now, huh."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「当たり前だ。その場には居合わせなかったが、
　情報なんぞいくらでも流れてくる」
dialogues.en: "Of course. I had sources at the scene of the crime."
dialogues.text: "Of course. I had sources at the scene of the crime."

dialogues.jp:
その場ってのは、もちろん、ミスコンの事だろ
う。
dialogues.en:
Of course, the scene he was talking about was the Miss
Kazami Academy Contest.
dialogues.text:
Of course, the scene he was talking about was the Miss
Kazami Academy Contest.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「ま、おめでとうと言っておこう」
dialogues.en: "Well, I guess I should say congratulations."
dialogues.text: "Well, I guess I should say congratulations."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「ありがとうと言っておこう」
dialogues.en: "I guess I should say thank you."
dialogues.text: "I guess I should say thank you."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「にしても、付属から上がるってのは、気楽な
　もんだな」
dialogues.en:
"Even after graduating a year, she's still so comfortable
with people."
dialogues.text:
"Even after graduating a year, she's still so comfortable
with people."

dialogues.jp:
再び、ことりに注意を促した。楽しげに喋って
いる彼女は、早くも輪の中心に居る。
dialogues.en:
He gestured once again towards Kotori, pretty much at the
center of attention of the girls and conversing with ease.
dialogues.text:
He gestured once again towards Kotori, pretty much at the
center of attention of the girls and conversing with ease.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「知った顔が居るから、授業初日から楽しく喋
　れる」
dialogues.en:
"When you see faces you recognize, of course you'd talk to
them first."
dialogues.text:
"When you see faces you recognize, of course you'd talk to
them first."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「……お前、友達作れよ」
dialogues.en: "...You, go make more friends."
dialogues.text: "...You, go make more friends."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「お前もな」
dialogues.en: "You too."
dialogues.text: "You too."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「けっ」
dialogues.en: "Gah."
dialogues.text: "Gah."

dialogues.jp: ガラガラ──
dialogues.en: --*bang bang*
dialogues.text: --*bang bang*

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「はいはい。どこでもいいから席着いてー。ホー
　ムルーム始めるよー」
dialogues.en:
"Alright, wherever you want to sit, just sit down. Homeroom
is about to begin."
dialogues.text:
"Alright, wherever you want to sit, just sit down. Homeroom
is about to begin."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: （……って、また暦先生が担任なのか）
dialogues.en:
"(...Don't tell me Koyomi-sensei is our form teacher
again.)"
dialogues.text:
"(...Don't tell me Koyomi-sensei is our form teacher
again.)"

dialogues.jp:
ことりといい杉並といい、知った顔がそれなり
に多いな。
dialogues.en:
Along with Kotori and Suginami, there's a surprising amount
of faces I recognize.
dialogues.text:
Along with Kotori and Suginami, there's a surprising amount
of faces I recognize.

dialogues.jp:
と、ふと視線を感じた。顔を巡らせると、こと
りが小さく手を振っていた。俺は軽くうなずい
た。
dialogues.en:
Then, I felt a pair of eyes on me. I turned to the source,
and saw Kotori giving a little wave. I replied with a short
nod.
dialogues.text:
Then, I felt a pair of eyes on me. I turned to the source,
and saw Kotori giving a little wave. I replied with a short
nod.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「はい、それじゃ、とりあえず、出欠を取りま
　しょうかね」
dialogues.en: "Alright, first of all, I'd mark attendance."
dialogues.text: "Alright, first of all, I'd mark attendance."

dialogues.jp: こうして、新学年での最初の１日が始まった。
dialogues.en: With that, the first day of the new school year began.
dialogues.text: With that, the first day of the new school year began.

dialogues.jp: ◆最初の一日◆
dialogues.en: ◆The First Day◆
dialogues.text: ◆The First Day◆

dialogues.jp: 新学年での最初の一日が始まった。
dialogues.en: The first day of the new school yeah began.
dialogues.text: The first day of the new school yeah began.

dialogues.jp:
ことりと言い、杉並と言い、暦先生と言い……
何だか、知った顔が多いな、
dialogues.en:
Kotori, Suginami, Koyomi-sensei... somehow, there's a lot of
people I know.
dialogues.text:
Kotori, Suginami, Koyomi-sensei... somehow, there's a lot of
people I know.
